paraphrasedFacts: The old town comprises the medieval core, former mining village, fishing village and later central urban part.
The central unit is described in connection with the38main road; the medieval core arose near the river confluence and Erzsébet királyné bridge.
Street-level descriptions connect the historic components with Rákóczi, Kis Albert tér, Serház, Vasvári Pál, Görög, Bethlen Gábor, Táncsics and Váradi streets.
